sentences.text: After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant does not want to press the present case as such, it may be dismissed as not pressed with liberty to move a discharge application before the Court concerned.
Shri Digvijay Singh, learned counsel for the respondent no. 2 has no objection to the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant.
As such, the present application is dismissed as not pressed with liberty to the applicant to move discharge application before the court concerned.
If any such application is preferred, the same shall be decided expeditiously, in accordance with law, if there is no any other legal impediment.
